title: CloudM Migrate — M365 → Google Migration Execution
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (enterprise Google Workspace migration/architecture).

Google Admin console / Cloud Identity and the Microsoft/Entra side authored at exact detail from the vendors' public docs. Third-party and Google-native MIGRATION TOOLS (Google Workspace Migrate, GWMME, BitTitan MigrationWiz, CloudM) are covered at the procedural playbook level — deep tool-console internals, licensing, and support are deferred to each vendor's own documentation, never invented; version-/preview-dependent behavior flagged 'verify for your version'. Gemini features flagged 'verify in your tenant'. Automation is Python (Admin SDK / APIs). No client names. No secrets/keys in code.
hook: Execute M365→Google migrations with CloudM Migrate
problem: CloudM Migrate is a common third-party engine for moving mail, files, and collaboration from Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace at scale. This solution is the CloudM execution playbook: configure the platform (hosted or self-hosted), connect M365 and Google, build the migration profile and user list, run scan/pre-stage and full/delta passes with throttling, and validate — so migrations complete reliably with minimal disruption.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the CloudM Migrate model (platform, connections, profiles, scan/pre-stage/delta), where it fits vs native + other tools, and the wave approach.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (CloudM platform + licensing, M365 + Google admin access/app registrations, user data, pilot scope).

Implementation Guide — configure the platform + connections, build the migration profile + user list, run scan/pre-stage + full/delta with throttling, validate, then scale waves — pilot-first; CloudM console internals + licensing deferred to CloudM docs, procedure and sequencing given.

5 Python tools — assessment/discovery, a configuration or orchestration helper, a validation/report generator, a policy/health check, and a scope/config helper — authentic Google Workspace Admin SDK / API automation (read-only or dry-run by default; no credentials or keys in code).
Validation gates (pilot complete, delta clean, errors triaged) plus Best Practices for reliable cutover sequencing.
short: Execute M365→Google with CloudM Migrate — platform + connections, migration profile/user list, scan/pre-stage and full/delta passes with throttling, and validation — so migrations complete reliably. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
